title: Property taxes by U.S. state, 2026
description: Property taxes in all 50 states and the District of Columbia: median real estate taxes paid on owner-occupied homes and median home values (U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 1-year), the effective rate they give, that rate on a $400,000 home, and whether each state’s taxes are paid in arrears or in advance, which decides who credits whom at closing.
notes: Also published with charts and methodology at https://brokerandagent.com/research/property-taxes-by-state
